content.title: Timm's Hill County Park
content.text: HomeFacilities Facilities View all facilities Features Boat landing Cross-Country Skiing Electricity Fishing Grill Hiking Observation Tower Parking Picnic Shelters Playground Restrooms Snowshoeing Swimming Trails Park Overview Timm's Hill County Park is open year-round. Winter parking is available at the intersection of Ring School Rd. and County RR.The highest point in the State of Wisconsin (at an elevation of 1,951.5 feet) is located at Timm's Hill in southeastern Price County. The park gate is open 7:30 a.m. - 9:30 p.m. approximately May through October. Bass Lake is completely surrounded by park property, as well as half the shoreline on Timm's Lake. The entire area is heavily forested with northern hardwoods and provides spectacular viewing during the fall color season.
